description_en: Specifies a threshold for the clean bandwidth of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS premium instance. If the threshold is reached, rate limiting is triggered
description_zh: 限速DDoS高防实例业务带宽
name: ConfigLayer4RealLimit

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
要限速的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the threshold of the clean bandwidth. Valid values: 0 to 15360. The value 0 indicates that rate limiting is never triggered. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 实例业务带宽限速值。取值：0～15360，0表示不限速。单位：mbps
